gdp_source: IMF World Economic Outlook, October 2026 (DataMapper API indicator NGDPD, GDP current prices, billions USD; 2025 values). Exceptions (per-country gdp_source_note): Cuba, Monaco, Syria, Greenland, New Caledonia from World Bank WDI NY.GDP.MKTP.CD (most recent non-empty year); Eritrea uses IMF's last available year (2019).
population_source: IMF World Economic Outlook, October 2026 (DataMapper API indicator LP, population, millions; 2025 values) (rounded to IMF's 3-decimal precision, i.e. nearest 1,000). Exceptions (per-country population_source_note): Cuba, North Korea, Monaco, Syria, Eritrea, Greenland, New Caledonia from World Bank WDI SP.POP.TOTL (2024); Western Sahara, Holy See, Falkland Islands as noted.
notes: IMF DataMapper values for 2025 retrieved 2026-11-16; DataMapper growth series matches the October 2026 WEO (e.g. Taiwan 2026 real GDP growth 10.7%).
Values were read via a web-fetch tool from the IMF JSON API; GDP in USD = IMF billions x 1e9, population = IMF millions x 1e6.
Verifier 2026-11-16: added COK (Cook Islands, AIIB member; no IMF/WB data, GDP/pop null) and CUW (Curaçao, WTO observer; World Bank WDI GDP 2024 and population 2025).
